verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI evaluation and observability SaaS platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis to ask about. However, the evidence pack documents only alerts on log metrics (metric, aggregation, threshold, time window) and never mentions registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive. Alerts are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for a webhooks story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
